title: Import Legacy Route Permission Consistency

items.action: enter legacy new-import aliases that redirect to import creation
select a fair when the legacy /imports alias redirects to the general import wizard

migration.reason: Existing Core permission codes are reused.

backend.reason: Backend authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contracts change; only legacy frontend route guards are aligned with their canonical redirect targets.

tenant_isolation.reason: No backend query or organization-scoping behavior changes.

audit.reason: Navigation redirects do not create auditable business mutations.

notes: Legacy /imports redirects to the general new-import wizard and therefore requires fair_crm.imports.create plus fair_crm.fairs.read, matching the canonical destination. Legacy /imports/fair/:fairId already supplies a fair id and redirects to the fair-scoped creation route, so it requires fair_crm.imports.create only. Redirect targets and backend authorization are unchanged.
